review_scope: All proposed manual Application assessments, ownership and historical supersessions. Actual reading pages specified per finding, not a whole-document claim for longer sources. Canonical data and packets were not edited.

SourcesReread.Method: Fresh pdfPages/htmlText on hash-verified actual bytes; relevant source identity/use/treatment paragraphs read independently. No source snippets or cached extraction were treated as originals.

Limitations: Manual coverage assessment only; no new product target pass, source admission, measurement/profile or environmental judgment is approved. Other named live products stay outside this exact-source scope.
